meta_description:
32K likes, 291 comments - official_amrit_fitness on September 15, 2026: "🍪 High-Protein Chai Biscuits 🍵

Healthy, homemade & perfect with your chai! 💪

✅ Recipe — Approx. 3 KG Batch

▪️ 1 kg Whole Wheat Flour
▪️ 500 g Oats Powder
▪️ 500 g Roasted Chana Powder (Sattu)
▪️ 450 g Desi Ghee
▪️ 700 g Jaggery Powder
▪️ 70 g Mixed Nuts
▪️ 50 g Mixed Seeds
▪️ 500 ml Milk (as required)
▪️ 25 g Baking Powder
▪️ 15 g Salt
▪️ Cardamom Powder (optional)

🔥 Bake at 165–170°C until light golden and crispy.

💪 Made with natural protein sources, complex carbs, healthy fats, fiber, vitamins & minerals.

🍪 3 biscuits ≈ 10 g protein

A nutritious homemade alternative for your everyday chai-time snack. ✅

🎥 Video by: @karamvisuals ☑️

#HighProtein #ChaiBiscuits #HealthySnacks #Homemade #HealthyFood".
